patterns.what_worked: Read the two audit reports first, then fixed the producers instead of the engine: every class cooldown/power/aura/health helper now routes through the core fix's restricted-aware helpers, returns nil on restricted, and records a per-tick flag the gather publishes as inputs_unknown (the display's suppression path). Aura probes are specific-id first with the list-wide fallback, so classic clients keep the exact old absent behaviour. Each class got an aura-only test leg where the hidden row is the only unknown source, making the H4 probes independently mutation-killable.
patterns.what_was_hard: The six class sandboxes differ (three build() factories, two global-env suites, mirrored-_G vs env._G compat loading), and the shaman chunk sits at Lua 5.1's local ceiling so its flag lives on the class table. Three pre-fix pins in the core desk's tests/secret_guard_state.lua assert the old degraded behaviour and needed filing rather than editing (out of scope).
patterns.skill_gap: None blocking; the mutation script had to do all cases in one shell invocation because /tmp is not shared between tool calls in this harness.

escalation.recommendation: Lead/owner applies the filed 3-line update to tests/secret_guard_state.lua (lines 787, 1203, 1462: old 0 -> nil + out.inputs_unknown == true) so the full harness returns to 57/0.
